description: This file contains CSS styles and variables for theme management in the application, defining colors for light and dark themes, and styling for various components such as the App, App-header, and theme toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container with text alignment, background color, and transition effects.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header of the application styled with background color and flexbox layout.

classes.description: Logo of the application with specified height and non-pointer events.

classes.description: Button for toggling themes with positioning, background color, and transition effects.
